Explorables are tier T3 of the playbook: pure JavaScript, no server, no
WebAssembly boot. They exist for one job — building intuition about a
**parameter**.

That job has a hard requirement: the chart has to answer instantly. A slider
that stalls for even half a second breaks the loop between moving it and
seeing the consequence, and that loop is the entire mechanism. Anything that
cannot be computed in a frame belongs in the [lab](/labs/index.qmd) or in a
chapter's baked charts instead.

They read the same `theme/palette.json` as everything else, so a color means
the same thing here as in the chapters. Being client-side, they also respond
to the theme toggle directly rather than being recolored after the fact.
